An alleged predator has no business serving in Congress. Eric Swalwell must RESIGN immediately.

Law and order means the justice system works as hard to protect victims as it does to defend predators.

Those who serve and protect our nation deserve a healthcare system supporting them and their families. 

We reintroduced the Military Moms Act to improve maternal healthcare resources for service members and their spouses.

ICYMI: ZERO illegal immigrants have been released into our country for the 11th month straight.

Under the Trump administration, and through the hard work of all Department of Homeland Security agencies, we are seeing the most secure border in American history.

A country with secure borders is a strong country.

Last year, we ranked as the 22nd most bipartisan member of Congress out of 435 members.

Doing the right thing isn’t about party. It’s about morals, common sense, and the best interests of South Carolina.

We work with the other side when they get it right and call out our own side when they get it wrong.

Getting results has never been about politics. It’s about doing what’s right, no matter the cost.

Amnesty is never the answer to illegal immigration, deportations are.

NO to the DIGNIDAD Act.

We’re calling on the Department of Justice to do what’s right: release ALL of the Epstein files and prosecute those responsible to the fullest extent of the law.

No one should escape accountability for the trafficking and abuse of women and children, no matter how powerful.

Any day now.

The swamp and their allies in corporate media are renewing their push for the largest amnesty in American history – the DIGNIDAD Act – a bill so bad for the American people they couldn’t even name it in English.

We will support EVERY effort to ensure Jeffrey Epstein’s victims get the justice they deserve. 

Thank you for your attention to this matter @FLOTUS.

When Melania Trump speaks with such grace and poise, the world listens.

Justice for the victims of Jeffrey Epstein.

As a survivor, this isn’t political, it’s personal and when the First Lady of the United States stands up and demands justice for Epstein’s victims, it is truly momentous. 

These women deserve to be heard. Today, they were.

We will NEVER back down.

First conviction under the Take It Down Act. 🇺🇸

Where’s the dignity for the victims of crimes committed by the millions of illegal aliens given amnesty?

Local leaders know what their communities need. Our job is to show up, listen, and deliver.

South Carolina STRONG 🇺🇸
